test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the idiom that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase in the following sentence.

I __finally understood__ how to operate the new smart television.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Figured out**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined phrase "**finally understood**" points towards an individual coming to comprehend or make sense of something after a period of confusion or effort.
 
• The term that closely aligns with this context is "**Figured out**" (समझना/पता लगाना).
 
 
• **Example**: After spending hours on the problem, he finally **figured out** the solution.
 
 
 
• "**Figured out**" denotes the process of solving a problem or understanding something complicated.
 
• Hence, the correct idiom is **Figured out**.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cast aside**: Refers to discarding or abandoning something or someone (त्याग देना/परे रख देना).
 
• **Hit the sack**: Means to go to bed, indicating that someone is going to sleep (सोने जाना).
 
• **Don’t know**: It's a phrase that signifies a lack of knowledge about something (नहीं पता).
